open_research_outside_scope: Brown extensions requiring at least nine old deletions
scope: For the fixed labelled Brown57 graph B, every finite simple undirected G on V(B) plus one new vertex with maximum degree <=8 and diameter <=2 must have at least 9 net old-edge deletions; its old-old addition count equals its deletion count. No exclusion of arbitrary order-58 graphs or >=9-deletion extensions.
